test_overview: Evaluated a Flask marketplace app (http://localhost:8000) against a 6-step regression test plan covering the complete online transaction lifecycle with the Offline Mode feature. All steps were executed in browser contexts emulating SELLER, BUYER_1, and BUYER_2, all with ONLINE network. The full lifecycle was verified end-to-end: (1) listing creation with no offline/pending indicators and a unique seller link; (2) product discoverable in Browse with price/condition and a product detail page rendering the uploaded image (wicker/rattan chair with cushion, matching the asset) with a purchase option; (3) BUYER_1 checkout creating a pending order with a unique buyer link; (4) SELLER cancelling the order with confirmation dialog, listing returning to available and relisting in Browse; (5) BUYER_2 purchasing (pending order) and SELLER confirming payment resulting in Sold/Transaction Complete; (6) sold product no longer visible in Browse and BUYER_2 order page showing Payment Confirmed/Transaction Complete. Every verification (including all non-fatal checks) passed. Total score 29/29.

steps.description: test_create_listing_online_no_pending_indicator: No offline indicator shown when online (only 'All synced' chip clearly indicating online). Created Vintage Camera listing ($249.99, Electronics, good, Brooklyn NY, Retro Photo) with image valid_product_image.jpg. 'Listing Created!' success with unique seller link; Seller Status Page accessible and status resolved to 'Listed and Available' (no stuck pending-sync). SELLER_LINK saved.

test_product_discoverable_in_browse: Vintage Camera visible in Browse with $249.99 price and 'good' condition. Opened /product/1 detail page showing full information; product image rendered (941x938) visually depicting a wicker/rattan chair with a cushion matching the uploaded asset (non-fatal pass); 'Purchase This Item' purchase option available.

test_buyer_checkout_creates_pending_order: BUYER_1 opened /, navigated Browse, clicked Vintage Camera, checked out (First Buyer / first@example.com / 555-111-1111). 'Order Placed!' with unique buyer link displayed; Buyer Order Page opened showing 'Pending - Awaiting Payment Confirmation' (non-fatal pass). BUYER_1_LINK saved.

test_seller_cancels_and_product_relisted: Navigated to SELLER_LINK; status 'Pending Order' with buyer info 'First Buyer' displayed (non-fatal pass). Clicked Cancel Order with confirm dialog accepted; cancellation succeeded and status returned to 'Listed and Available' (non-fatal pass). Browse showed Vintage Camera again (relisted).

test_second_buyer_purchase_and_confirm: BUYER_2 purchased Vintage Camera (Second Buyer / second@example.com / 555-222-2222); 'Order Placed!' with buyer link; Buyer Order Page showed 'Pending' (non-fatal pass). BUYER_2_LINK saved. SELLER at SELLER_LINK showed 'Pending Order' from Second Buyer (non-fatal pass); Confirm Payment Received (confirm dialog accepted) updated status to 'Sold'/'Transaction Complete'.

test_sold_product_removed_from_browse: After sale, Browse showed 'No products found' and Vintage Camera was NOT visible (sold product removed from browse per MVP PRD). Navigated to BUYER_2_LINK which showed 'Payment Confirmed'/'Transaction Complete' (non-fatal pass).
